simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אִבְחָה (H19) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: אִבְחָה (ʼibchâh) means brandishing of a sword First listed occurrence: Ezek 21 20.

definitions.full: H19. ibchah [ אִבְחָה ] noun feminine construct חֶרֶב אִבְחַת Ezek 21:20 ; Dl, as above, slaughter ; but probably error for טבחת (see טבח ) Ges Co; ᵐ5 σφάγια ρὁμφαίας , compare ᵑ7 . אֲבַטִּיחִים see בטח . אָבִי see ביה . אֲבִי see אֲבִיָּהוּ below II. אבה . הָעֶזְרִי אֲבִי see אֲבִיעֶזֶר below II. אבה . אֲבִיָּה see אֲבִיָּהוּ below II. אבה . אֲבִיהַיִל see אֲבִיחַיִל below II. אבה . אֲבִיּוֺנָה אֶבְיוֺן, see I. אָבָה . אֲבִיָּם see אֲבִיָּהוּ below II. אבה . אֶבְיָסָף see אֲבִיאָסָף below II. אבה .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root (apparently meaning to turn);
